lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Top plate (1) to end plate (4), about 90 deg. In sections at 5/25/50/75/95% the label sits on the outer-skin apex within 0.01-0.09 mm, and the inner arc is concentric about 3.6 mm inside. The station scan finds the outer apex from t=0 to about 57 mm, and the line spans 0 to 57.2 mm. It ends at the blended miter corners on both sides.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Top plate (1) to side flange 5, about 90 deg, along the full length. Section offsets are 0.00-0.09 mm. The fold's outer apex runs from t=0 to about 121 mm (the corner blend starts at about 122), and the line spans 0 to 121.7 mm. The line is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Top plate (1) to side flange 7, about 90 deg, along the full length. Section offsets are 0.00-0.06 mm. The apex runs from t=0 to about 121 mm, and the line spans 0 to 121.9 mm. The line is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: End plate (4) to its side flange on the 5 side, about 90 deg, from the relief notch up to the miter corner. Section offsets are 0.00-0.03 mm, rising to 0.2 mm at 95% where the line meets the corner blend. Before the notch, the flat lower part of the end plate continues (b=-3.2, no fold), so the fold correctly starts at the notch. The fold runs from about -1 to 63 mm, and the line spans 0 to 62.6 mm.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: End plate (4) to its side flange on the 7 side, about 90 deg, from the relief notch to the miter corner. Section offsets are 0.00-0.04 mm, and 0.17 mm at 95%. The apex is present from t=0 to about 62 mm, and the line spans 0 to 60.6 mm, which still covers at least 80%.
